extension.summary: JELLYNAS home rows for Kodi: continue watching, next up, recently added, spotlight, this week, all movies and series, Seerr catalog
JELLYNAS kezdőlap-sorok a Kodiban: folytatás, következik, nemrég hozzáadott, kiemelt, ezen a héten, összes film és sorozat, Seerr-katalógus
extension.description: Widget folders for skins such as Arctic Fuse 2, built like the JELLYNAS Jellyfin home page. Continue watching and Spotlight come from the Jellyfin server with the Kofin login of this Kodi (read only); episodes show the series name. This week comes from Streambox (week.json), IMDb ratings from Streambox (imdb.json). Playback goes through Kofin.

Widget-mappák skinekhez (pl. Arctic Fuse 2), a JELLYNAS Jellyfin-kezdőlapja mintájára. A Megtekintés folytatása és a Kiemelt a Jellyfin-szerverről jön, ennek a Kodinak a Kofin-belépésével (csak olvasás); a részeknél a sorozat neve látszik. Az Ezen a héten a Streamboxból (week.json), az IMDb-pontszámok a Streamboxból (imdb.json) jönnek. A lejátszást a Kofin végzi.
extension.news: 0.2.8: Recently added series keeps its cards when the extra fill query fails (it was empty); the Catalog falls back to the public address on any LAN check error, not only on network errors. 0.2.7: the Catalog works away from home: when the LAN address of the catalog proxy does not answer, the add-on uses the public address (kept for 10 minutes); a changed address in the settings is used as is. 0.2.6: recently added movies and series show up to 30 cards (was 24); the series row is filled up with the series that got new episodes most recently, because Jellyfin groups only the newest few dozen episodes and one big import left a single card. 0.2.5: after a request the Catalog rows of the JELLYNAS skin reload at once (the new request shows in Requests); IMDb ratings are read again every 30 minutes instead of 6 hours, so a new title gets its badge sooner. 0.2.4: catalog Details: the Play button plays an available movie or opens an available series in Kofin. 0.2.3: card second lines for the poster look of the JELLYNAS skin: episodes S1:E5, recently added movies year and length, recently added series year and seasons, else the year; This week cards carry the IMDb value again (Available goes to the bottom). 0.2.2: trending catalog row split into movies or series (type=movie or tv) for the Catalog page of the JELLYNAS skin; texts for its tabs. 0.2.1: catalog badge for partially available titles is the short word Partly (it did not fit). 0.2.0: Catalog (Seerr through the JELLYNAS catalog proxy): trending, popular and upcoming movies and series, the requests (all, processing, coming soon, available); a card offers play (Jellyfin), request (after a yes/no, in your own Seerr name; series: the missing seasons or chosen ones) and details. Setting: catalog server address. 0.1.8: All movies and All series take the Home grid bar filters of the JELLYNAS skin: sort (newest, title, year, IMDb rating), first letter, unwatched only, genre (chosen in a dialog from the Jellyfin genres). 0.1.7: New folders All movies and All series: the whole library newest first for a category poster wall (Poster Wall view), with the IMDb badge, watched mark, unwatched episode count and the Kodi sort menu (date added, title, year, rating, play count); a series opens its seasons in Kofin. 0.1.6: This week info panel like the other rows: an available episode shows its own Jellyfin overview, length and streams, the others the series overview. 0.1.5: New folders Next up, Recently added movies, Recently added series (as on the Jellyfin home page, with the IMDb value; a series card opens its seasons in Kofin); This week cards carry an Available badge instead of IMDb. 0.1.4: This week without day cards: the day and time (TODAY for today) in the second line of each card, the state in the plot. 0.1.3: This week: series images with their real tags (backdrop when no Thumb), day cards with the day name. 0.1.2: works through the public address (own User-Agent, the proxy refused the default one). 0.1.1: the language setting is saved (new settings format), new icon. 0.1.0: first version: Continue watching, Spotlight, This week
